to.ask: Which city are you flying to?

city.ask: In which city do you need a room?

route.ask: Which one does the request ask for?

flights.what:
Find the next flights to a city.
Tonight's flights, each with its code and departure time, the best first; nothing is booked.
not_for: booking a seat on a flight
finding hotel rooms in a city
whether a flight is on time
examples: search for a flight to berlin
which flights still go to madrid
i need another flight to berlin

rooms.what:
Find hotel rooms in a city for tonight.
Each hotel with its price a night, the cheapest first; nothing is booked.
not_for: booking the hotel
finding flights to a city
a meeting room at the office
examples: look for a hotel room in madrid
hotels in berlin with a free room
what rooms are free in lisbon
I need a hotel in berlin for tonight
where can I sleep in lisbon tonight

calendar.what:
Show the meetings on your calendar for a day.
Each meeting's title and time; nothing on the calendar changes.
not_for: moving meetings to another day
adding a meeting or an event
asking what the date is
examples: my calendar for the day after tomorrow
show my schedule for this monday
how does today look on my calendar
what meetings do I have on friday

book.what:
Book a seat on a flight by its code.
The fare is charged to the travel account and the ticket goes to your inbox; there is no undo.
not_for: finding flights to a city
booking the hotel
cancelling a booked flight
checking in for a flight
telling a channel about a booking
examples: get me a seat on TP1051

hotel.what:
Book a hotel room for tonight.
One night at the first hotel of the rooms just found, on the travel account; the booking can be cancelled.
not_for: finding hotel rooms in a city
booking a seat on a flight
booking a taxi or a table
telling a channel where you are staying

meeting.what:
Move a day's meetings to another day.
Every meeting of the day the calendar just showed, to the day you name or else the day after; a later move puts them back.
not_for: showing a day's meetings
cancelling a meeting
adding a new meeting
changing a flight to another day
telling a channel the meetings moved
examples: shift those meetings to this wednesday

tell.what:
Post a message to a chat channel.
The message is the words that asked for it, posted to one of your team's own channels and nowhere else.
not_for: an email or a message to one person
a reminder for yourself
reading what a channel said
examples: let #team know the client review moved
post in #travel that the hotel is booked
tell the travel channel my flight was cancelled
let my team know I am stuck in madrid
